= Journal 2026-05-08 =

== Vim Pandoc Compiler ==
:pandoc:compiler:vim:

[[https://github.com/vim-pandoc/vim-pandoc|vim-pandoc]] provides compiler settings for Vim.

[[https://github.com/vim-pandoc/vim-pandoc|vim-pandoc]] defines and sets a
'compiler' pandoc
that can be started by ':make' or ':lmake' and
compiles the current file by pandoc.

The `:Pandoc` command uses
`g:pandoc#compiler#command` and
`g:pandoc#compiler#arguments`.

- [[/diary/2024-01-20#Convert Vimwiki Wikilinks to Markdown with Pandoc|Convert Vimwiki Wikilinks to Markdown with Pandoc]]
- [[/diary/2024-01-20#Convert Vimwiki Todo Lists Wiki Lints to Markdown with Pandoc|Convert Vimwiki Todo Lists Wiki Lints to Markdown with Pandoc]]
- [[/diary/2024-01-20#Convert Vimwiki Tasks to Markdown `mdformat-myst`|Convert Vimwiki Tasks to Markdown `mdformat myst`]]

=== `:compiler pandoc` review ===

In this setup, **`:compiler pandoc` resolves to the user package version
from `vim-pandoc`**, not the Vim 9.1 system compiler, because
`vimfiles/pack/python/start/vim-pandoc` appears on `runtimepath` before
`/usr/share/vim/vim91`.

| Source                                                                              | Behavior                                                                                                                       |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **System Vim 9.1** `/usr/share/vim/vim91/compiler/pandoc.vim`                       | Full-featured compiler wrapper with filetype detection, title/lang metadata, output extension handling, and extra-arg support. |
| **Active user package** `vimfiles/pack/python/start/vim-pandoc/compiler/pandoc.vim` | Minimal wrapper that sets `makeprg` to `pandoc` plus configured arguments and uses a pandoc-friendly `errorformat`.            |

==== System Vim 9.1 features ====

- Runs `pandoc --standalone`.
- Infers `--from=` from the current buffer filetype.
  Special cases include `pandoc -> markdown`, `tex -> latex`,
  `xml -> jats`, and unknown or empty types falling back to `markdown`.
- Lets `:make` choose the output extension, such as `:make html` or
  `:make pdf`.
- Writes output to the current file stem with the requested extension:
  `%:r.$*`.
- Adds a title automatically unless the buffer already has a Pandoc title
  block or YAML `title:`.
- Can add `--metadata lang=...` from `b:pandoc_compiler_lang`, or from the
  first two letters of `spelllang` when spell checking is on.
- Accepts extra flags through `b:pandoc_compiler_args` or
  `g:pandoc_compiler_args`.
- Parses pandoc diagnostics with `"%f", line %l: %m`.

==== Active user-package features ====

- Sets `makeprg` to `g:pandoc#compiler#command` if defined, otherwise
  `pandoc`, plus `g:pandoc#compiler#arguments`.
- Uses the same pandoc-style `errorformat` as the system compiler.
- Does **not** provide the Vim 9.1 conveniences for automatic input format
  mapping, automatic title/lang metadata, `:make html` or `:make pdf`
  output-file templating, or automatic current-file insertion.

==== Repo-specific customization ====

This repo sets:

```vim
let g:pandoc#compiler#arguments =
      \ '--to=markdown'
      \ .. ' --from=markdown-header_attributes+wikilinks_title_after_pipe-task_lists'
      \ .. ' --wrap=preserve --standalone'
```

So here, `:compiler pandoc` effectively prepares `:make` to run pandoc as a
**Markdown-to-Markdown reformatter or converter**, not the richer system
`vim91` compiler workflow.
